name: Facet
text: Ship the live HTML/CSS prototype tonight using mocked API responses. It proves the interface works end-to-end, keeps the team aligned on real interactions, and meets the visibility and liveliness goals faster than a static mockup. The trade-off is that the mocked data won’t reflect live backend quirks, but we’ll iterate on that tomorrow once the core flow is proven.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Shipping a live prototype with mocked API responses risks hiding the fragility of real network calls—latency, retries, and partial failures—until the interface breaks under load. A better alternative is shipping a static mockup first, then layering in real API calls only after the core interactions are stable and measurable. Settle it by running a controlled test: compare the static mockup’s performance against the live prototype with mocked responses, and decide based on which reveals the real user experience faster.
